verdict.rationale: SavvyCal workflows are native event-driven automations. You attach them to links (or auto-attach them to new links), and they run multi-action steps timed before or after meetings. They adapt when a meeting is rescheduled (steps move) or cancelled (steps are called off), and they can include a 'Send a webhook' action. Signed webhooks on events like event.created, plus an official Zapier app, extend this to external actions. Missing for 10: documented conditional or filter logic within rules, triggers beyond the meeting lifecycle, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
